glosses: Used to express irritation, indignation, or a similar emotional response to something against one's will; roughly equivalent to some usages of of all.
Used to express the fact that the speaker thinks something is unlikely.

examples.text: Warum hast du ausgerechnet das getan?
examples.en: Why did you choose to do that?

examples.text: Müssen wir ausgerechnet hier darüber sprechen?
examples.en: Do we have to talk about this here?

examples.text: Warum haben Sie ausgerechnet das getan?
examples.en: Why did you choose to do that?

examples.text: Warum hast du ausgerechnet dieses Lied gesungen?
examples.en: Why did you choose to sing that song?
